title: Prime-field tensor generators for constructible complexes
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, put $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work in the ordinary derived categories of module sheaves on the small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a commutative ring $R$, write $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for complexes with bounded cohomology admitting a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on each stratum of which (after restriction) each cohomology sheaf is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], i.e. locally constant with finitely generated $R$-module stalks [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; for $R=\Lambda$ this is [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. For a finitely generated $A$-module $N$, let $N_X$ be its constant module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The category $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ is exactly the smallest strictly full subcategory of $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ containing every object $$N_X\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}F,\qquad N\text{ a finitely generated }A\text{-module},\quad F\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda),$$ and closed under integer shifts, cones of morphisms between its objects, finite direct sums, and direct summands. The tensor is [def-kun-derived-tensor], with the $A$-action on $N_X$. The shifts, cones and summands are taken in the ordinary derived category with its usual triangulated structure [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Expose XVII, Proposition 7.4.6 (finite filtration with direct-summand tensor quotients), p. 307, and Proposition 7.4.1 and its proof, pp. 305, 308
